description: Avrupa Bölgesi Plansız Elektrik Kesintileri is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by EPİAŞ. AVRUPA Bölgesindeki gerçekleşen plansız elektrik kesintilerinin veri setidir. Coverage: EPİAŞ. The publisher named on the listing is EPİAŞ. Its keywords include AVRUPA, elektrik, elektrik kesinti, enerji. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2025-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
